label: Strength sessions
h1: Keep your muscle on GLP-1: a 3-day strength calendar

items.b:
Warm up with 3 minutes of easy marching or walking.

• Chair sit-to-stands: 3 sets of 8–12. Slow down, stand up with control.
• Wall or counter push-ups: 3 sets of 8–12.
• Hip hinge (hands on thighs, push hips back): 3 sets of 10.
• Farmer's carry: hold two bags of groceries or jugs and walk for 30–45 seconds. Do it 3 times.

Stop any move that causes sharp pain. Leave 2–3 reps 'in the tank'. Have a protein-containing meal or snack in the next couple of hours.

Warm up with 3 minutes of easy marching or walking.

• Step-ups onto a low step: 3 sets of 8 each leg, holding a rail if needed.
• Band or towel rows (pull elbows back): 3 sets of 10–12.
• Glute bridge: 3 sets of 10–12.
• Dead bug or bird dog: 2 sets of 8 each side, slow.

When 12 reps feel easy, add a little load (a backpack with books, a heavier jug) or slow the lowering phase.

Sunday check: plan a protein source for each meal this week (eggs, Greek yogurt, fish, chicken, tofu, beans, cottage cheese).

When appetite is low, smaller and more frequent protein-forward snacks are easier than big meals. Ask your prescriber or a dietitian for a personal target.

Warm up with 3 minutes of easy marching or walking.

• Chair sit-to-stands: 3 sets of 8–12. Slow down, stand up with control.
• Wall or counter push-ups: 3 sets of 8–12.
• Hip hinge (hands on thighs, push hips back): 3 sets of 10.
• Farmer's carry: hold two bags of groceries or jugs and walk for 30–45 seconds. Do it 3 times.

Stop any move that causes sharp pain. Leave 2–3 reps 'in the tank'. Have a protein-containing meal or snack in the next couple of hours.

Warm up with 3 minutes of easy marching or walking.

• Step-ups onto a low step: 3 sets of 8 each leg, holding a rail if needed.
• Band or towel rows (pull elbows back): 3 sets of 10–12.
• Glute bridge: 3 sets of 10–12.
• Dead bug or bird dog: 2 sets of 8 each side, slow.

When 12 reps feel easy, add a little load (a backpack with books, a heavier jug) or slow the lowering phase.
